text: Which protein kinases are never seen in the nucleoplasm?
plan: Protein class: Enzymes / Kinases AND NOT Subcellular location (ICC): Nucleoplasm
understanding: The query asks for genes classified as protein kinases that are excluded from being localized to the nucleoplasm according to immunocytochemistry (ICC) subcellular location data.

trail.why: Selecting the class 'Enzymes' and subclass 'Kinases' precisely targets all protein kinases specified by the requirement.

Selecting 'Nucleoplasm' at level 1 covers all instances where the protein is seen in the nucleoplasm so that they can be excluded, leaving level 2 unrestricted to capture any reliability or annotation class.

requirements.why: Identifies genes categorized under the kinase subclass/class in HPA.
Negates the filter for nucleoplasm localization in immunofluorescence cell line assays to exclude proteins observed in the nucleoplasm.
